# Move player RIGHT to cols 19-23
action(['RIGHT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
print(f"After RIGHT: Player cols {[c for r,c in player['boundary']]}")

# Check remaining green targets
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green targets: {len(greens)}")
for g in greens:
    rows = [r for r,c in g['boundary']]
    cols = [c for r,c in g['boundary']]
    print(f"  rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Click green targets at cols 13-17 (player is no longer there)
for g in greens:
    g_cols = [c for r,c in g['boundary']]
    g_min, g_max = min(g_cols), max(g_cols)
    g_rows = [r for r,c in g['boundary']]
    g_min_row = min(g_rows)
    
    # Check overlap with player
    p_cols = [c for r,c in player['boundary']]
    p_min, p_max = min(p_cols), max(p_cols)
    
    if g_min <= p_max and g_max >= p_min:
        print(f"Skipping green at cols {g_min}-{g_max} (overlaps player)")
        continue
    
    # Click this green target
    click_row = g_min_row + 2
    click_col = g_min + 2
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': click_row, 'col': click_col}])
    print(f"Clicked at ({click_row}, {click_col})")
    
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("Game over!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("Level completed!")
        break

# Check state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
print(f"\nRemaining green: {len(greens)}")
print(f"Player: {player['boundary']}")

p_objs = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
print(f"Purple goals: {len(p_objs)}")
for p in p_objs:
    print(f"  {p['boundary']}")

print(f"Result: {last_action_result}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
